content: Reading the test image to analyze the plant disease symptoms.

The image shows a green leaf with a single, well-defined circular lesion. The lesion has:
- A dark brown/reddish-brown center (necrotic eye-like spot)
- A yellow halo surrounding the brown center
- Clear concentric ring pattern resembling an "eye"
- The rest of the leaf appears healthy green

This is a classic presentation of **Brown Eye Spot** — a fungal disease (typically *Cercospora coffeicola* on coffee or similar pathogens on other hosts) characterized by circular spots with a brown/reddish center and a distinct yellow chlorotic halo, giving the appearance of an eye. The single, isolated lesion with this "target" pattern is highly diagnostic.
